All set. Here's what I did:

1. **Created** `beat-link-trigger/` folder in your DjTools project
2. **Downloaded** Beat Link Trigger v8.0.0 (macOS Apple Silicon) 
3. **Installed** it to `/Applications/Beat Link Trigger.app`

You can launch it with:

```
open "/Applications/Beat Link Trigger.app"
```

Or just find "Beat Link Trigger" in Spotlight. Note: on first launch macOS may block it — if so, go to **System Settings → Privacy & Security** and click "Open Anyway".

Sources:
- [Beat Link Trigger Releases](https://github.com/Deep-Symmetry/beat-link-trigger/releases)
- [Beat Link Trigger GitHub](https://github.com/Deep-Symmetry/beat-link-trigger)
